title: Round 5 (v5): C pilot (leakage-route optimism) + level-4 pilot (environment dissimilarity as an applicability signal), G2F primary
status: FROZEN before round-4 results are known and before any round-5 analysis. Executed after round 4 per user's sequential instruction; nothing in this spec may be changed in response to round-4 results.

data_splits.G2F: round-1 forward years 2019/2020/2021 (77 test envs), round-1 features
data_splits.BRIWECS: round-3 forward years 2018/2019 (23 test envs), round-3 features (secondary)

models_common.M_G: SNP main effects only (no EC terms)
models_common.env_mean_model: ridge of env-mean yield on EC_env (21 G2F / 12 BRIWECS) trained on training envs; evaluated by Pearson r between predicted and observed env means across test envs (G2F n=77) - reported for C1 and C2

C1_anchor_leak.leak_free: EC_env anchored at env-mean PREDICTED silking/heading (round-1/3 spec)
C1_anchor_leak.leaky: EC_env anchored at the OBSERVED mean silking/heading of the test env (emulates tuning a crop model/phenology to observed target-environment phenology, as in APSIM GDD tuning)
C1_anchor_leak.optimism: metric(leaky) - metric(leak_free) for M0plus within-env r and for env-mean r

C2_window_search_leak.index: CERIS-style: over variables {T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, T2M, PRECTOTCORR, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, GWETROOT, VPD} (G2F) and windows [d1,d2] in days after planting, d1 in 0..140 step 5, d2 in d1+10..d1+60 step 5, compute env-level window mean; select the (variable, window) maximizing |Pearson| with env-mean yield
C2_window_search_leak.model: SNP main + (PC1..30 x selected index) + index main, ridge with round-1 penalty rule
C2_window_search_leak.optimism: metric(leaky) - metric(nested) for within-env r and env-mean r (env-mean model = linear on selected index)
C2_window_search_leak.scope: G2F only (BRIWECS weather variables differ; not run)

C3_selection_leak.nested: penalty chosen on last training year (round-1 rule)
C3_selection_leak.leaky: penalty chosen to maximize the TEST-year within-env r (emulates epoch/hyperparameter selection on the evaluation fold)

C_pilot.rank_flip_check: does the ordering of {M_G, M0, M0plus} by mean within-env r differ between all-leaky and all-nested evaluation?

decision.C_TARGET: optimism >= 0.02 (within-env r or env-mean r) with paired env-bootstrap CI lower > 0 for >=1 route, OR a rank flip -> plan C at the target tier
decision.C_STABLE: otherwise -> C as an evaluation-protocol note (stable tier)

L4_pilot.dissimilarity: for each test env: mean Mahalanobis distance (pooled training covariance with ridge 1e-3 on the diagonal) of its standardized EC_env vector to its 5 nearest training envs
outcomes: per-env G x E contribution = r(M0plus) - r(M_G)
L4_pilot.test: Spearman rho between dissimilarity and each outcome; permutation p (10,000 shuffles of dissimilarity across test envs, stratified by test year)
L4_pilot.PASS: G2F (primary, n=77): rho <= -0.25 AND p < 0.05 for the G x E contribution outcome
L4_pilot.if_PASS_exploratory: gated model: use M0plus when dissimilarity <= tau else M_G, tau chosen on the last training year; report forward r(gated) - r(M0plus) with CI (exploratory only; a confirmatory test would need its own prereg)
L4_pilot.FAIL: otherwise -> no applicability signal from EC dissimilarity at this scale

metric_and_uncertainty: within-env Pearson equal-weight over test envs; paired env bootstrap 2000, seed 20260928
reporting_rules: results frozen as JSON with sha256
